title: Publish from a spreadsheet
subtitle: Publish or update your whole catalog at once: download the template, fill it in Excel or Google Sheets and upload it.

steps.templateBody: It comes with the instructions, the categories and the values you can use.
steps.catalogHint: To edit what you already published: download your catalog, change the rows and upload it again. Don't delete the ID column.
steps.uploadBody: We check every row before publishing. Rows with errors are not published; the others are.

refs.instruction: How to fill in the spreadsheet

products.1: Each row of the Products sheet is one product. Don't change the column titles.
products.2: Columns marked * are required for a new product.
products.3: Leave the ID empty to publish a new product. To change one you already published, download your catalog and edit its row without touching the ID. Empty cells change nothing.
products.4: Subcategory: write the ID shown in the Categories sheet.
products.5: Materials: write code:percentage separated by |, for example {{example}}. They must add up to 100. The codes are in the Materials sheet.
products.6: Prices in pesos, without dots or a $ sign. If the product is on offer, the offer price must be lower than the price.
products.7: Yes/no: write yes or no. Tags, features, badges and photos: separate the values with |.
products.8: Photos: up to 3 per product. A product without a photo is saved unpublished; add photos in Catalog and photos and turn it on. Only photos already uploaded to EKORU work in this column, like the ones in your downloaded catalog.
products.9: Units, size and badges: use the values in the Values sheet.
products.10: You can upload up to {{max}} rows per file.

services.1: Each row of the Services sheet is one service. Don't change the column titles.
services.2: Columns marked * are required for a new service.
services.3: Leave the ID empty to publish a new service. To change one you already published, download your catalog and edit its row without touching the ID. Empty cells change nothing.
services.4: Subcategory: write the ID shown in the Categories sheet.
services.5: Pricing type: use the values in the Values sheet. Except for quoted services (QUOTATION), the price must be above 0.
services.6: Price in pesos, without dots or a $ sign. Duration in minutes and service radius in kilometres.
services.7: Yes/no: write yes or no. Tags and photos: separate the values with |.
services.8: Photos: up to 3 per service, and services can be published without one. Add them in Catalog and photos. Only photos already uploaded to EKORU work in this column, like the ones in your downloaded catalog.
services.9: You can upload up to {{max}} rows per file.
